mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 3% signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS remains below 3% for the full horizon, or Rank IC <0.05 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in unemployment rate above 4% triggers a labor market weakening, reducing corporate investment and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4%, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) above their 5-month moving averages signal economic expansion, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite both proxies exceeding thresholds, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in the federal funds rate below 2.5% amplifies accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not positive in >50% of late-cycle instances, or FEDFUNDS doesn't stay below 2.5% for full horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3%) signals tight monetary policy, raising discount rates on equities and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL >3%, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in jobless claims (PAYEMS > 1.5 million) indicates labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not negative despite PAYEMS exceeding threshold, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in demand (HOUST) and supply (INDPRO) above their 3-month moving averages signal robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) despite both proxies exceeding thresholds, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a contraction phase regime, a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals tightening policy, elevating risk premiums and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative in >70% of contraction instances, or FEDFUNDS doesn't stay above 4.5% for full horizon.
